page.layout: One printed page, text only. Above the text a decorative woodcut ornament (not transcribed). Title block at top: "CL. V.", addressee lines and sender's name with "S. D." in the centre. Body text in one column, large initial M, running to the foot. No margin notes. Foot: signature "* 2" at left, catchword "non" at right.

main_text.head: M. MARTINO FÜSSELIO SERENISSIMO ELECTORI BRANDENBURGICO A CON-CIONIBUS ET CONSI-liis sacris,
main_text.p: MEMINISTI, Frater & affinis honorande, petivisse te à me ante biennium: ut, quæ ego in Anglia collegissem scripta lectu digna, & Germanis nondum visa, vel per Chalcographorum manum tibi communicarem. Nondum satisfeci promissis, idq; ideo, quia redeuntem ex Marchia alia atq; alia nunc itinera, nunc negotia fatigâ-runt. Nuper vero aliquid otii cum nactus essem, excussi supellectilem meam librariam, &

page.notes: Show-through of the word "EPISTOLA" (mirrored, upside down) at the top of the page and faint ghost text along the left edge were not transcribed. The text continues on the next page; "non" is the catchword. The sender's name is set in a script-like type, rendered here in italics. Spellings of u/v and i/j were normalised per the rules, e.g. "petivisse", "otii". No printing errors were found.
